title: Book Edition 2 revision A: correctness items A-G, Figure 6/7 redesign, glossary terms, tranche-A visuals
source_handoff: owner-supplied external review of the Edition 2 PDF, items A-G and visuals 2.1/2.3/2.7/2.8; plan approved 2026-09-24
acceptance_criteria: minor-variants.typ no longer says relaxed freshness may return an older value 'for a bounded window'; it states relaxed is a named family and only bounded staleness declares a maximum delta, matching cache-consistency.typ and glossary.typ

major-families.typ rollup Mechanism distinguishes same-database/same-transaction maintenance from cross-boundary publication (delivery, idempotency, retry, reconciliation); how-to-choose.typ scopes application-rollup write cost to the measured configuration-portal workload

information-placement.typ text equivalent no longer calls all five placements 'a copy' while stating derive keeps none; derive stores no additional copy and the remaining rungs add stored derived structure or copy

concurrency-control.typ states pessimistic contention is paid as waiting/blocking rather than optimistic retries, that latency may rise or fall by workload, and that application retries may still be needed (deadlock, lock timeout, serialization failure); the 1.76x result stays scoped to one hot key and 16 writers in one run

derived-state-and-history.typ separates derived state (rollup, rolldown, external copy) from retained history (event/ledger, audit, temporal, snapshots) and drops 'the only structures'; major-families.typ drops 'writes append and fence' and says append-only storage does not itself settle concurrency

glossary.typ defines the eight distinct terms (invalidation, fill lease, fencing token, source-generation validation, cache CAS, hit validation, transactional outbox, TTL/early expiry); the cache chapter's publication-fence card names source-generation validation distinctly from sink-side fencing tokens and cache CAS

fig-lease-vs-fence is redrawn with five lifelines (R1, R2, lease/token coordinator, source DB, cache/sink) and three panels: lease-only unsafe, sink-side fencing token, and a labelled distinction from source-generation publication validation; the coordinator no longer publishes to the cache and the note no longer says 'the source generation rejects it'

fig-cache-stale-fill is redrawn with explicit S0/v0 to S1/v1 provenance and the mechanism named source-generation publication validation; its caption and text equivalent scope it to the stale-fill race only

Four new figures are registered, embedded once, labelled form x evidence status with a text equivalent and no embedded figure number: fig-families-er and fig-rollup-vs-rolldown (2.1), fig-history-vs-derived (2.3+2.7), fig-topology-physical-boundary (2.8)
No measured number, claim id, trial count, evidence classification, confound or gap is changed; book/evidence is untouched
book/assets/export.sh --check passes, book/evidence/check.sh passes, and a scratch book/build.sh preview verifies with 29/29 claims, 6/6 fonts, digest present, no banner and no unresolved tokens
expected_artifacts: redrawn figure 6 and figure 7 sources and assets
four new tranche-A figure sources and assets
